meanings.en: in a way that is possible to imagine or believe
meanings.exampleEn: The project could conceivably be finished by next month.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje muhtemelen gelecek aya kadar bitirilebilir.

meanings.en: in a way that can be imagined
meanings.exampleEn: It was, imaginably, the worst outcome they could face.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, hayal edilebileceği üzere, karşılaşabilecekleri en kötü sonuçtu.

meanings.en: not preserved or treated by curing
meanings.exampleEn: The recipe calls for uncured bacon without added nitrates.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarif, nitrat eklenmemiş işlenmemiş pastırma gerektiriyor.

meanings.en: not having been treated or prepared by a special process
meanings.exampleEn: She prefers unprocessed foods like fresh fruit and vegetables.
meanings.exampleTr: Taze meyve ve sebze gibi işlenmemiş gıdaları tercih eder.

meanings.en: having been subjected to a chemical or physical process
meanings.exampleEn: Only treated water should be used for drinking here.
meanings.exampleTr: Burada içmek için yalnızca arıtılmış su kullanılmalıdır.

meanings.en: preserved by salting, drying, or smoking
meanings.exampleEn: They served thin slices of cured ham with melon.
meanings.exampleTr: Kavunla birlikte ince dilim salamura jambon servis ettiler.

meanings.en: not cut, shortened, or edited
meanings.exampleEn: The director released the full uncut version of the film.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetmen filmin tam, sansürsüz versiyonunu yayınladı.

meanings.tr: otlarla kaplanmış, gür ve bakımsız büyümüş
meanings.en: covered with plants that have grown thickly and untidily
meanings.exampleEn: The garden was overgrown with weeds after months of neglect.
meanings.exampleTr: Aylarca ihmal edildikten sonra bahçe otlarla kaplanmıştı.

meanings.en: made neat by cutting away unwanted parts
meanings.exampleEn: The neatly trimmed hedges lined the front path.
meanings.exampleTr: Özenle budanmış çitler ön yolu sınırlıyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being unusual or unfamiliar
meanings.exampleEn: There was a strangeness about the empty town that unsettled her.
meanings.exampleTr: Boş kasabada onu huzursuz eden bir tuhaflık vardı.

meanings.en: the state of being uncommon or scarce
meanings.exampleEn: Snow is a rarity in this part of the country.
meanings.exampleTr: Kar, ülkenin bu bölgesinde nadir görülen bir şeydir.

meanings.en: the condition of being usual or expected
meanings.exampleEn: After the storm, life slowly returned to normality.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınadan sonra hayat yavaşça normale döndü.

meanings.en: not showing care for the consequences of an action
meanings.exampleEn: It would be imprudent to invest all your savings in one company.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm birikiminizi tek bir şirkete yatırmak tedbirsizlik olur.

meanings.en: lacking experience, wisdom, or judgment
meanings.exampleEn: It was naive of him to trust a complete stranger with the money.
meanings.exampleTr: Parayı tamamen yabancı birine emanet etmesi onun saflığıydı.

meanings.en: to care for and encourage the growth of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Good teachers nurture their students' curiosity.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi öğretmenler öğrencilerinin merakını besler.

meanings.en: an improvement that makes something better in quality or value
meanings.exampleEn: The software update brought several performance enhancements.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılım güncellemesi birkaç performans iyileştirmesi getirdi.

meanings.en: parallel to the ground; level from side to side
meanings.exampleEn: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page.
meanings.exampleTr: Sayfanın ortasına yatay bir çizgi çizin.

meanings.en: turned upside down or reversed in position
meanings.exampleEn: The image appeared inverted in the mirror.
meanings.exampleTr: Görüntü aynada ters çevrilmiş göründü.

meanings.en: changed to the opposite direction or order
meanings.exampleEn: The decision was reversed after a public outcry.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar, kamuoyu tepkisinin ardından tersine çevrildi.

meanings.en: relating to a large, busy city and its surrounding area
meanings.exampleEn: The metropolitan area is home to over ten million people.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükşehir bölgesi on milyondan fazla insana ev sahipliği yapıyor.

meanings.en: in an urgent or insistent manner
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke pressingly about the need for immediate action.
meanings.exampleTr: Acil eylem ihtiyacı hakkında ısrarla konuştu.

meanings.en: the quality of being helpful or practical
meanings.exampleEn: The tool soon proved its usefulness on the job site.
meanings.exampleTr: Alet, şantiyede kısa sürede yararlılığını kanıtladı.

meanings.en: the quality of having no use or value
meanings.exampleEn: He complained about the uselessness of the broken machine.
meanings.exampleTr: Bozuk makinenin işe yaramazlığından şikayet etti.

meanings.en: not being used or lived in; empty
meanings.exampleEn: The house had been unoccupied for several years.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev birkaç yıldır boştu.

meanings.en: the act of injecting a vaccine to protect against disease
meanings.exampleEn: Children receive an inoculation against measles at an early age.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklara erken yaşta kızamığa karşı aşı yapılır.

meanings.en: the process of making a person resistant to a disease
meanings.exampleEn: The clinic offers free immunization for travelers.
meanings.exampleTr: Klinik, yolcular için ücretsiz aşılama sunuyor.

meanings.en: not legally or officially acceptable; not valid
meanings.exampleEn: Your ticket is invalid because the date has expired.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarihi geçtiği için biletiniz geçersizdir.

meanings.en: to become real or actually happen
meanings.exampleEn: The promised funding never materialized.
meanings.exampleTr: Vaat edilen finansman hiçbir zaman gerçekleşmedi.

meanings.en: not involving or using words or speech
meanings.exampleEn: Much of human communication is nonverbal, like gestures and facial expressions.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsan iletişiminin çoğu, jestler ve yüz ifadeleri gibi sözsüzdür.

meanings.en: by spoken words or by mouth
meanings.exampleEn: The medicine should be taken orally twice a day.
meanings.exampleTr: İlaç günde iki kez ağızdan alınmalıdır.

meanings.en: in a written form rather than spoken
meanings.exampleEn: Please confirm your agreement in writing.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen onayınızı yazılı olarak iletin.

meanings.en: a form of something that differs slightly from others
meanings.exampleEn: This is a regional variant of the traditional recipe.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, geleneksel tarifin bölgesel bir varyantıdır.

meanings.tr: kıdemli kişi, eski toprak, tecrübeli yaşlı
meanings.en: a person who has been in a place or activity for a long time
meanings.exampleEn: The old-timers at the bar remembered when the mill was still running.
meanings.exampleTr: Bardaki eski topraklar, değirmenin hâlâ çalıştığı zamanları hatırlıyordu.

meanings.en: a trembling or quivering movement
meanings.exampleEn: The shaking of her hands revealed how nervous she was.
meanings.exampleTr: Ellerinin titremesi ne kadar gergin olduğunu ortaya koyuyordu.

meanings.en: the state of being strong, active, and full of energy
meanings.exampleEn: Despite his age, he was full of vitality and good humor.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşına rağmen, canlılık ve neşe doluydu.

meanings.en: a lack of energy and enthusiasm
meanings.exampleEn: A heavy meal left him in a state of lethargy all afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağır bir yemek onu tüm öğleden sonra bir uyuşukluk içinde bıraktı.

meanings.en: in a weak manner, lacking strength
meanings.exampleEn: The injured bird flapped its wings feebly.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaralı kuş kanatlarını güçsüzce çırptı.

meanings.en: a person who lives in a city
meanings.exampleEn: Many city-dwellers dream of a quiet life in the countryside.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok şehirli, kırsalda sakin bir hayatın hayalini kurar.

meanings.en: virtual reality; a computer-generated simulated environment
meanings.exampleEn: He put on the headset and explored the museum in VR.
meanings.exampleTr: Kulaklığı taktı ve müzeyi VR'da gezdi.

meanings.en: an imitation of a real process or situation
meanings.exampleEn: Pilots train using a flight simulation before flying real planes.
meanings.exampleTr: Pilotlar gerçek uçaklarla uçmadan önce uçuş simülasyonu kullanarak eğitim alır.

meanings.en: the quality of being good or morally right
meanings.exampleEn: She believed in the basic goodness of people.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanların temel iyiliğine inanırdı.

meanings.en: in a way that cannot be seen
meanings.exampleEn: The repair was done so invisibly that no one noticed the crack.
meanings.exampleTr: Onarım o kadar görünmez biçimde yapıldı ki kimse çatlağı fark etmedi.

meanings.en: in a way too slight or gradual to be noticed
meanings.exampleEn: The temperature dropped almost imperceptibly during the night.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcaklık gece boyunca neredeyse fark edilmeyecek kadar düştü.

meanings.en: a person compulsorily enrolled for military service
meanings.exampleEn: The young conscript was sent to the border for training.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç er, eğitim için sınıra gönderildi.

meanings.en: to vomit (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: He felt so seasick that he wanted to puke.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar deniz tuttu ki kusmak istedi.

meanings.en: a person who has the right to vote in an election
meanings.exampleEn: Every registered elector received a ballot by mail.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıtlı her seçmen, posta yoluyla bir oy pusulası aldı.

meanings.tr: karın orta bölgesi, bel ile göğüs arası
meanings.en: the front part of the body between the chest and the waist
meanings.exampleEn: The top was cut short, leaving her midriff bare.
meanings.exampleTr: Üst kısa kesilmişti ve karın bölgesini açıkta bırakıyordu.

meanings.en: a sleeveless garment worn on the upper body
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a wool vest under his jacket for warmth.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcak tutması için ceketinin altına yün bir yelek giydi.

meanings.en: a person who goes for long walks in the countryside
meanings.exampleEn: The hiker reached the summit just before sunset.
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüşçü, gün batımından hemen önce zirveye ulaştı.

meanings.en: a board of plaster used to form interior walls
meanings.exampleEn: They hung new drywall before painting the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Odayı boyamadan önce yeni alçıpan astılar.

meanings.en: board made of plaster set between layers of paper, used for walls
meanings.exampleEn: The builders fixed sheets of plasterboard to the ceiling.
meanings.exampleTr: İnşaatçılar tavana alçıpan levhalar sabitledi.

meanings.en: a large warship with heavy guns and thick armor
meanings.exampleEn: The mighty battleship anchored in the harbor.
meanings.exampleTr: Heybetli savaş gemisi limana demir attı.

meanings.en: an armed sailing ship of the past
meanings.exampleEn: A British man-of-war engaged the enemy fleet at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir İngiliz savaş gemisi şafakta düşman filosuyla çarpıştı.

meanings.en: a period when a country is not at war
meanings.exampleEn: The army was much smaller during peacetime.
meanings.exampleTr: Ordu, barış zamanında çok daha küçüktü.

meanings.en: a large stinging insect of the wasp family
meanings.exampleEn: A hornet flew into the kitchen and everyone panicked.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfağa bir eşekarısı girdi ve herkes panikledi.

meanings.en: made or fastened so that water cannot get in or out
meanings.exampleEn: The container is completely watertight, so nothing leaks.
meanings.exampleTr: Kap tamamen su geçirmezdir, bu yüzden hiçbir şey sızmaz.

meanings.en: allowing liquids or gases to pass through
meanings.exampleEn: Sandy soil is permeable and drains quickly after rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Kumlu toprak geçirgendir ve yağmurdan sonra hızla suyu emer.

meanings.en: the liquid that carries nutrients through a plant
meanings.exampleEn: Sticky sap oozed from the cut in the tree trunk.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağaç gövdesindeki kesikten yapışkan özsu sızdı.

meanings.en: in a way that is slight and hard to perceive
meanings.exampleEn: The room smelled faintly of lavender.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda hafifçe lavanta kokuyordu.

meanings.en: made very poor; lacking resources
meanings.exampleEn: Aid was sent to the most impoverished regions of the country.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin en yoksul bölgelerine yardım gönderildi.

meanings.en: the way a surface or substance feels to the touch
meanings.exampleEn: The fabric had a soft, smooth texture.
meanings.exampleTr: Kumaş yumuşak, pürüzsüz bir dokuya sahipti.

meanings.en: thin and easily broken or damaged
meanings.exampleEn: The shelter was a flimsy structure of cardboard and string.
meanings.exampleTr: Barınak, mukavva ve iplikten derme çatma bir yapıydı.

meanings.tr: düşük ücretli, hak ettiğinden az ödenen
meanings.en: paid too little for the work done
meanings.exampleEn: Many nurses feel overworked and underpaid.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok hemşire fazla çalıştırıldığını ve düşük ücret aldığını hissediyor.

meanings.en: earning or providing only a small amount of money
meanings.exampleEn: Many low-paid workers struggle to afford rent.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok düşük ücretli işçi kirayı karşılamakta zorlanıyor.

meanings.en: relating to the countries of the West
meanings.exampleEn: The book contrasts occidental and oriental philosophies.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap, Batılı ve Doğulu felsefeleri karşılaştırıyor.

meanings.en: a man whose wife has died and who has not remarried
meanings.exampleEn: The elderly widower lived alone with his cat.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı dul adam kedisiyle yalnız yaşıyordu.

meanings.en: a remote, uncultivated, or uninhabited region
meanings.exampleEn: They spent a week camping in the wilds of Alaska.
meanings.exampleTr: Alaska'nın ıssız doğasında bir hafta kamp yaparak geçirdiler.

meanings.tr: ücra kırsal bölge, dağlık ıssız alan
meanings.en: a sparsely inhabited rural area far from towns
meanings.exampleEn: The skiers ventured into the backcountry away from the resort.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayakçılar, tesisin uzağındaki ücra dağlık bölgeye açıldılar.

meanings.en: in a willing and happy manner
meanings.exampleEn: I would gladly help you move this weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hafta sonu taşınmana seve seve yardım ederim.
